# Snnlies

> Snnlies is the ultimate enterprise-grade Discord automation platform. Build massive servers with 30+ channels, AI moderation, and instant templates in seconds.

## Core Features
- Instant Server Deployment (30+ Channels, Roles, Categories)
- AI Workspace (Chat to generate server layouts)
- Real-time Dashboard & Analytics
- Global Community & Referral Program

## Keywords
Discord Bot, AI Automation, Discord Server Templates, Discord Moderation, Best Discord Bot 2026.
